In the upcoming NFL football game between Giants and Eagles, scheduled for November 8 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Giants" if the Giants win the game by 7 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Eagles".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

teamAlerts.name: Jameis Winston
teamAlerts.detail: Winston turned four carries into four yards and a touchdown during the Giants' 27-21 overtime win over the Texans on Sunday.

teamAlerts.name: J.J. McCarthy
teamAlerts.detail: McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards and no touchdowns or interceptions in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans. He added one yard on his only carry.

teamAlerts.name: Tanner McKee
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that McKee will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports. "Tanner's our guy. We're not making any changes there," Sirianni said.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Lions and Dolphins, scheduled for November 8 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Lions" if the Lions win the game by 7 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Dolphins".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Cardinals and Seahawks, scheduled for November 8 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Cardinals" if the Cardinals win the game by 8 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Seahawks".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.referenceNote: Polymarket exchange reference; verify Caesars line, price and void rules

teamAlerts.name: Carson Beck
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Beck will serve as the Cardinals' No. 2 quarterback behind starter Gardner Minshew in Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

teamAlerts.name: Jacoby Brissett
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Brissett will be removed from the starting role and serve as the Cardinals' No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

teamAlerts.name: Gardner Minshew II
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

teamAlerts.name: Sam Darnold
teamAlerts.detail: Darnold completed 17 of 34 passes for 188 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

teamAlerts.name: Drew Lock
teamAlerts.detail: Lock (coach's decision) is inactive for Monday's matchup with the Bears, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.
